sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The hosts will be firm favourites against bottom-half Alsager, who sit second-bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and arrive in poor form with five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough test away at Dawley Town, a side with mixed recent form, and will be eager to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. In the upper half, AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what should be a competitive clash between two of the division's stronger outfits, while Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in another mid-table fixture. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in decent recent form, visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby. Elsewhere, Barnton entertain Shawbury United—the latter desperately needing points after five consecutive defeats—while New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a battle of mid-table strugglers. Crewe travel to face in-form Allscott Heath, and Telford Town, another relegation-battler, visit struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads. Finally, Widnes Town, bottom of the league with just 2 points, make the journey to Brereton Social, with both sides desperately seeking a positive result.
